name: knoggin
description: Long-term memory from Knoggin, on your own machine or your own server. Recall is read-only. The agent saves what you ask it to keep and what is worth keeping, and tells you what it saved.

interface.longDescription: Knoggin keeps short text memories and finds them again by meaning. The plugin recalls without changing anything. It saves what you ask it to keep and what is worth keeping, and tells you what it saved. To stop it from saving, connect it with a read-only key.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about this project?
Recall my preferences for this kind of task.
